title: Watercolor 144 Buttercup Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:-*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count. **This home is allowed 12 amenity access bands.**- Located in WaterColor's Park District- Access to neighborhood pools, beach club, playground, and nature trails- Professionally designed- 2 primary suites- Screened-in porch- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: "The Big Chill" is the perfect hideaway for families and friends looking to stay in the idyllic community of WaterColor. Located in the Park District, this professionally designed 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home can sleep 12 guests and is surrounded by forest views with Western Lake and the Gulf nearby. 4 adult bikes are provided for everyone to cruise to and from the beach and along 30A without ever needing a car! Access to nature trails, playgrounds, and the recently renovated WaterColor beach club are also included in the amenities. There is also a carriage house which can sleep 2 for those looking for extra privacy. The first floor features a completely renovated kitchen, with premium stainless-steel appliances and seating for 10 at the main dining table. It opens up to the spacious living area, including a fireplace, flat-screen TV, and floor-to-ceiling windows with forest views and access to the screened-in porch. Upstairs, guests will find 3 primary suites. Each bedroom has a king bed with plush, white bedding, a flat-screen TV, and ensuite bathroom. No one has to sacrifice comfort or privacy! Next door is the carriage house with king bed, private bathroom, and separate kitchen, dining, and living room. The screened-in back porch is the perfect spot to sip coffee in the morning and enjoy the tranquility of the Gulf breeze. This home is ideal for laidback families looking for a quiet getaway and stay a short bike ride away from the beach and town center. Don't miss your chance to stay at "The Big Chill". Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR: Living Area: Queen Sleeper SofaSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyPrimary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyQueen Sleeper SofaWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesPlease note that pets are not allowed in this home.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one Low-Speed Vehicle per home. Homes with owner provided Low-Speed Vehicles are not permitted to rent an additional Low-Speed Vehicle.
